title: SelfCheck
description: Self-check of the AI parts at start (W1703 rule 2, Bogen 35 R11): per AI one state with a clear text and a fix hint as i18n keys. The game shows it calmly and always keeps running (rule 3). GET /setup/check.

ai.description: Which AI: language (decider, talking), image (pictures in the night), sound (not planned for players in the first release, W1703).

state.description: ok; preparing (download, start or loading under way); problem (the player can fix it, see fix_key); not_offered (this hardware tier offers no such model); not_planned (not part of this release).

reason.description: Machine-readable cause, e.g. runtime_missing, model_missing, folder_unknown, comfyui_down, nodes_missing.

message_key.description: i18n key of the clear text (msg.selfcheck.<ai>.<reason>).

fix_key.description: i18n key of the fix hint (msg.selfcheck.<ai>.<reason>.fix); null when there is nothing to do.

detail.description: Names that belong into the text, e.g. the missing ComfyUI nodes; empty if none.
